pavilion.note: walk on the lower roof edge (56 px above the ground) and up to the peak (80)

arch_bridge.walk_line: top of deck: y above ground = 6+22*(1-((x-59.5)/59.5)^2), x from the left edge

koi_pond.note: place so the 5th row from the top is the ground line; the 9 rows below sink into the ground

hall_end.walk_line: ridge 160 px above the ground for x 0..62 from the left edge, then the hip falls steeply and sweeps out nearly level to an upturned eave tip (about 126 px up) at x=127; the hall continues to the left, the garden is on the right; flip it for the other end
